question.text: Per SEBI's Investor Charter and complaints disclosure framework, within how many days of the end of each quarter must AIFs compile their investor complaints data and disclose it to investors and SEBI?

answer.text: Within 7 days from the end of quarter
Within 15 days from the end of quarter
Within 30 days from the end of quarter
Within 45 days from the end of quarter

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 13.5.1, AIFs shall maintain investor complaints data for each quarter (ending March, June, September, December) and for the last three financial years. The data needs to be COMPILED within 7 days from the end of quarter and disclosed to investors and SEBI. The complaint-response timeline separately is 30 days (Annexure 13.1 Timeline table). The Trap: 15/30/45 days are commonly used timelines for other filings (e.g., 30 days for complaint redressal, 30 days for PPM change intimation). The 7-day compilation window is specific. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-A tests complaint redressal window (30 days). XIX-C drills into the quarterly compilation cycle (7 days). Manager's Pro-Tip: Automate complaint-log dashboards keyed to quarter-ends — a manual compilation every quarter is error-prone. Ensure RTA/Fund Admin feeds complaints data into your MIS in near-real time.
